topic_title: Reducing Risk — Licensing, Registration & Insurance Synthesis
prompt: How does repeated speeding and moving violations impact a driver's legal and economic standing in Texas?

options.text: Causes license suspension, dramatically escalates insurance premiums, and risks jail
Results merely in temporary administrative delays with zero financial insurance impact
Has no effect on insurance rates as long as tickets are paid within ninety days
Grants exemption from future roadside speed checks under DPS point waiver rules
